items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And they brought in Hank Jones and Kenny Barron and Benny Golson and Kenny Burrell and on and on and on. And I was working with almost all of them.

ctx.x: You seem to be the guy on call in San Diego for the jazz films they do.

Yes. Those Club Dates, on PBS. I’m actually doing one next Saturday with Bucky Pizzarelli. I’m doing one with Bucky so that will be fun. Yeah, it’s been a real nice series. We actually had a jazz club back some years ago called Laurio’s. And they brought in Hank Jones and Kenny Barron and Benny Golson and Kenny Burrell and on and on and on. And I was working with almost all of them. A lot of them I knew and had worked with before, some of the people, Art Pepper and some of the guys I had worked with at other…
Were your kids aware of what you did for a living, and did they think it was out of the ordinary?
